name: SMACv2
description: SMACv2 is an improved benchmark for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning that introduces procedurally generated scenarios and extended partial observability to require closed-loop policies and generalization to unseen settings.
reputation: Widely adopted as a successor to SMAC, addressing its limitations and providing a more challenging testbed for MARL research.
notes: Introduces stochasticity and partial observability to better benchmark closed-loop policies in multi-agent RL.
